title: Password ssh returns sshpass_missing — update the plugin (OpenSSH askpass path)
symptom: launch_cli.py ssh ends with sshpass_missing (an older plugin required sshpass for password logins)
cause: Plugins before #987 needed sshpass for passwords. Current versions fall back to OpenSSH SSH_ASKPASS (OpenSSH 8.4+) with a single password attempt
fix: Update the plugin, then rerun the same launch_cli.py ssh command
With a key: launch_cli.py ssh --cred <server> --key-path <key file> --command '<command>'
If ssh is older than OpenSSH 8.4 and still prompts or fails, use pro-ssh's scripts/ssh_connect.py (paramiko) — skills/pro-ssh/SKILL.md
